name: Indian Heritage & Culture
description: Art forms, literature, architecture from ancient to modern times, temple styles, Buddhist/Jain art, classical dances, music.

name: Modern Indian History
description: Mid-18th century until independence, British colonial policies, socio-religious reform movements, tribal/peasant uprisings.

name: Freedom Struggle
description: Stages of national movement, Congress, extremists, moderates, Gandhian phase, INA, revolutionary movements, partition.

name: Post-Independence India
description: Reorganization of states, tribal consolidation, wars, emergency, linguistic policy, green revolution political impacts.

name: World History
description: Industrial revolution, World Wars, redrawal of national boundaries, decolonization, political philosophies like communism, capitalism, socialism.

name: Indian Society
description: Salient features of Indian society, diversity, role of women, population, poverty, urbanization, globalization effects, secularism, communalism, regionalism.

name: Geography
description: Physical geography, distribution of key natural resources, factors for industrial location, geophysical phenomena (earthquakes, cyclones, volcanoes).

name: Constitution & Polity
description: Historical underpinnings, basic structure, fundamental rights, directive principles, federalism, inter-state relations, constitutional amendments.

name: Governance & Civil Services
description: E-governance, citizen charters, transparency, accountability, RTI, role of civil services in democracy, NGO/SHG roles.

name: Parliament & State Legislatures
description: Structure, functioning, conduct of business, powers & privileges, decline of legislature, parliamentary committees, anti-defection law.

name: Constitutional & Quasi-Judicial Bodies
description: Election Commission, CAG, UPSC, Finance Commission, National Commissions for SC/ST/OBC, tribunals, regulatory bodies.

name: Social Justice & Welfare
description: Welfare schemes for vulnerable sections, health, education, human resources, issues relating to poverty and hunger.

name: International Relations
description: India and its neighbourhood, bilateral, regional and global groupings, agreements involving India, diaspora, international institutions (UN, WTO, IMF).

name: Indian Economy & Budgeting
description: Indian Economy, planning, mobilization of resources, growth, development, employment, government budgeting, fiscal policy, inflation, banking.

name: Agriculture & Food Security
description: Cropping patterns, irrigation, farm subsidies, MSP, PDS, food processing, supply chain management, land reforms.

name: Infrastructure & Investment
description: Energy, ports, roads, airports, railways, investment models (PPP, BOT, HAM), logistics, urban infrastructure.

name: Science & Technology
description: Developments in IT, space, computers, robotics, nanotechnology, biotechnology, issues relating to intellectual property rights (IPR).

name: Environment & Biodiversity
description: Conservation, environmental pollution and degradation, environmental impact assessment (EIA), climate change, Paris agreement, green energy.

name: Internal Security
description: Linkages between development and spread of extremism, external state and non-state actors, cyber security, money laundering, border management.

name: Disaster Management
description: Disaster preparedness, NDMA guidelines, disaster risk reduction (DRR), Sendai framework, floods, urban heat islands, earthquakes, landslides.

name: Ethics & Human Interface
description: Essence, determinants and consequences of ethics in human action; dimensions of ethics; ethics in private and public relationships; human values.

name: Attitude & Aptitude for Civil Services
description: Attitude: its content, structure, function; its influence on thought and behavior; moral and political attitudes; civil service foundational values.

name: Emotional Intelligence
description: Concepts, and their utilities and application in administration and governance; empathy, compassion towards weaker sections.

name: Probity in Governance
description: Concept of public service; philosophical basis of governance and probity; information sharing, transparency, RTI, code of ethics, citizen charter, corruption.

name: Moral Thinkers & Philosophers
description: Contributions of moral thinkers and philosophers from India and world: Socrates, Plato, Aristotle, Kant, Bentham, Mill, Gandhi, Tagore, Ambedkar.

name: Case Studies on Ethical Dilemmas
description: Case studies on problems of integrity, conflict of interest, crisis management, political pressure, social boycott, ethical dilemmas in public office.

name: Philosophy & Abstract Thought
description: Reflective, quote-based, and paradoxical statements testing wisdom, human condition, character, resilience, means vs ends.

name: Society & Social Justice
description: Gender parity, women empowerment, patriarchy, social inequalities, youth, social media dynamics, customary vs modern morality.

name: Polity & Governance
description: Constitutional morality, democracy, state effectiveness, people's participation, rule of law, classrooms shaping national destiny.

name: Economy & Development
description: Inclusive development, globalization, technology as enabler, sustainable subsistence, poverty, shared spaces vs conflicts.

name: Science, Tech & Environment
description: Technological outsourcing of self-discovery, cyberspace blessings/curse, alternative climate technologies, innovation determinants.

name: International Affairs & Geopolitics
description: Non-alignment relevance, multi-polar world, South Asian cooperation, global peace, international conflicts.

name: Culture, Education & Heritage
description: Classrooms shaping destiny, cultural identity, linguistic heritage, tourism potential, national synthesis.

name: Ethics & Values
description: Means and ends, moral courage, values vs behavior, power and responsibility, simplicity as sophistication.
